shortDescription: Manage SMB global settings on a PowerScale Storage System

options.name: access_based_share_enum
options.description: Only enumerate files and folders the requesting user has access to.

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: api_user
options.description: username of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: dot_snap_accessible_child
options.description: Allow access to .snapshot directories in share subdirectories.

options.name: dot_snap_accessible_root
options.description: Allow access to the .snapshot directory in the root of the share.

options.name: dot_snap_visible_child
options.description: Show .snapshot directories in share subdirectories.

options.name: dot_snap_visible_root
options.description: Show the .snapshot directory in the root of a share.

options.name: enable_security_signatures
options.description: Indicates whether the server supports signed SMB packets.

options.name: guest_user
options.description: Specifies the fully-qualified user to use for guest access.

options.name: ignore_eas
options.description: Specify whether to ignore EAs on files.

options.name: onefs_cpu_multiplier
options.description: Specify the number of OneFS driver worker threads per CPU.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: onefs_num_workers
options.description: Set the maximum number of OneFS driver worker threads.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: reject_unencrypted_access
options.description: If SMB3 encryption is enabled, reject unencrypted access from clients.

options.name: require_security_signatures
options.description: Indicates whether the server requires signed SMB packets.

options.name: server_side_copy
options.description: Enable Server Side Copy.

options.name: server_string
options.description: Provides a description of the server.

options.name: service
options.description: Specify whether service is enabled.

options.name: support_multichannel
options.description: Support multichannel.

options.name: support_netbios
options.description: Support NetBIOS.

options.name: support_smb2
options.description: The support SMB2 attribute.

options.name: support_smb3_encryption
options.description: Support the SMB3 encryption on the server.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
